limitations: Declared scan pairs from one public sequence; no reference extrinsic or accuracy claim.
Spatially capped voxel centroids are identical for both methods; this does not measure whole raw-cloud registration or the full calibrate CLI pipeline.
All iterations and diagnostic settings are unchanged between methods. Solver convergence/degeneracy status remains visible in every full payload.
Three timing repetitions are not independent accuracy trials or confidence. Host and process/OS caches are shared; no portable speed guarantee.
Input capture and preparation cost is recorded separately, charged once for this experiment, not included in solver wall: {"0000000000:0000000115": 1.8943217999767512}

Local paths are normalized to ${WORKSPACE_ROOT} and ${DATASET_ROOT}. Every complete numerical payload and original input/config/output digest is unchanged. Output digests bind canonical JSON payloads, not a standalone result file.
